cases.note: The gate derives the applicable Federation closure and requires evidence for every required MUST.
Missing, skipped, inconclusive or failed required evidence is a binary hard denial.
Federation and governance security requirements cannot be compensated by quality metrics.
The bounded gate requires an exact policy-version reference for the governance hard-gate cases.
A remote self-asserted TRUSTED status is not accepted as local qualification evidence.
Federation evidence cannot be widened into TRUSTED without the additional profile closure.

known_limitations: The gate consumes deterministic evidence records but does not implement the durable QualificationBundle, signing, build/environment identity or baseline lifecycle.
The current fixture does not prove every full profile requirement, runtime surface, migration, adapter, cryptographic or PostgreSQL gate.
This fixture is evidence-only and does not claim a qualified GOVERNANCE, FEDERATION, TRUSTED or v0.4 profile.
